title: Reinforcement Learning via Advantage Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2610.19783v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) holds the promise of learning a policy that can outperform what is shown in the data. However, in practice, such systems suffer from instability and hyperparameter sensitivity. In contrast, supervised learning provides a stable and scalable training objective, but is fundamentally limited by the quality of the demonstrated behavior. In this paper, we ask whether we can perform policy optimization with something as simple and stable as supervised learning but as performant as RL. Unfortunately, naively training the policy with supervised learning and conditioning on future rewards or advantages typically underperform dedicated RL methods. We introduce a new policy extraction method, Advantage Guidance, that retains the simple supervised learning structure with advantage conditioning while outperforming prior RL methods through effective conditional training and contrastive diffusion guidance during sampling. translated_title: 基于优势引导的强化学习
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）有望学习到能够超越数据中所展示行为的策略。然而在实践中，这类系统往往存在不稳定性和超参数敏感的问题。相比之下，监督学习提供了稳定且可扩展的训练目标，但从根本上受限于示范行为的质量。在本文中，我们探讨是否能够以一种像监督学习一样简单稳定、却又像强化学习一样高性能的方式来进行策略优化。遗憾的是，简单地用监督学习训练策略并以未来奖励或优势作为条件，其表现通常不如专门的强化学习方法。我们提出了一种新的策略提取方法——优势引导，它在保留带有优势条件化的简单监督学习结构的同时，通过有效的条件化训练和采样过程中的对比扩散引导，超越了先前的强化学习方法。
tldr: 提出了一种名为“优势引导”的新策略提取方法，将优势条件化的监督学习结构与采样时的对比扩散引导相结合，实现了像监督学习一样稳定、却比以往强化学习方法性能更强的策略优化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Advantage Guidance, a new policy extraction method that combines advantage-conditioned supervised learning with contrastive diffusion guidance during sampling, achieving stability comparable to supervised learning while outperforming prior reinforcement learning methods.
